title: Russia ramps up attacks on Kyiv infrastructure as U.S. makes fresh push for peace talks
summary_full: Russia has pledged to intensify strikes on Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities after a drone attack damaged the capital’s key Northern Bridge over the weekend.
